encounter_reward_vs_fail.instructions: Given ambient deltas (typically ±3–18 gold/sanity/bond, occasional −5 health) and action fail costs, is the current reward curve balanced against fail risk for M1 targets (median 8–12 min, first-time win 35–50% after one loss)?

criteria.keep_v1_curve: Ship as-is; tune only after 10 human playtests
criteria.soften_fail_costs: Lower battleLoseHealth / navigateFailSanity to raise first-time win rate
criteria.raise_rewards: Increase ambient gold/tear yields so repair+bond are less grindy
criteria.raise_risk: Increase ambient negative deltas or tick pressure for more tension
criteria.add_retry_cushion: Keep costs but add a soft checkpoint / partial gold retain on death

status_effects_v1_1.instructions: Should corruption/static status effects ship in v1.1 or stay deferred?

criteria.defer_to_phase6: No status effects until campaign systems; keep vitals binary
criteria.v1_1_corruption_only: One stackable corruption that only drains sanity
criteria.v1_1_pair: Corruption + static (heal block or action lock) with JSON-driven rules
criteria.v1_0_hot_add: Retrofit status effects immediately before public HN push

elohim_content_pack.instructions: Import Elohim Shards quest ribbon / voices as content pack vs stay original for Phase 1?

criteria.flavor_only: Optional side notes / random events with CC BY 4.0 attribution; not main quest
criteria.full_quest_ribbon: Replace main objectives with Elohim quest_graph.json as primary spine
